Import daily tracker report


Each office’s report is saved separately. Importing a date replaces that date for this office only.




Assign existing data to an office


Data loaded


Copies for management (no sharing needed)
Each copy is one HTML file holding the data and settings loaded right now. An office copy holds only that office’s vehicles, staff and settings. The Admin / COO copy holds every office. Save each file in its own OneDrive or SharePoint folder under the same name every day, so managers always open the newest one. Copies are snapshots and do not update by themselves.


How the daily import works
  • Import each day’s report as it is exported. Dates found in the file replace any data already held for those dates; all other days are kept, so the history builds up day by day.
    • 

  • Imports by dashboard editors are saved for everyone, and every manager sees them straight away. Other viewers can import too, but only in their own browser; an editor can share those days later.
  • Reading happens locally in the page: the Excel file is not uploaded anywhere.



Policy and cost settings
Saved automatically and shared with everyone who opens the dashboard. Only editors can change them.






Assumptions
  • Idling is ignition on while stationary, taken from the tracker trip report. Idle fuel = idle hours × burn rate. The default 1.83 L per hour was fitted from 2,193 trips in this data; replace it with figures per vehicle type when known.
    • 

  • Speed violations compare each trip’s maximum speed from the tracker with the speed limit. The tracker reports one maximum per trip, not each speeding event, so time and place of the exact moment are not available.
  • Fuel use per vehicle on the Performance page is estimated as distance × 0.099 L per km plus idle hours × the burn rate, because the tracker’s fuel sensor is blank or inconsistent on many vehicles.
  • After-hours means a trip that starts outside the team’s duty timing (plus the grace minutes), on a weekly off, or on a holiday. Approved on-call teams and drivers are reported but not counted as unapproved. After-hours fuel ≈ 0.099 L per km (fitted from this data) plus idle hours × burn rate.
  • Fuel prices are the UAE November 2026 rates: Special 95 AED 4.04, Diesel AED 4.75, E-Plus 91 AED 3.97, Super 98 AED 4.16.
  • Excess cost counts only idling beyond the daily allowance. Monthly projection = average daily excess × 30.


Data still required
  • Staff ID per driver (not in the tracker export).
  • Area and supervisor roster: area is currently the district where each trip ended, and team stands in for the supervisor.
    • 

  • Event-level idling report with start, end and coordinates. The tracker gives idling per trip, so “events” counts trips with at least the chosen minutes of idling.
  • Vehicle master with type and fuel type, for per-vehicle burn rates. Sensor fuel is zero or blank on 27 vehicles, so cost uses hours × rate.
    • 

  • Speeding events report (time, location and duration above the limit) for exact violation points.
  • History beyond five days for a true monthly view and a 30-day repeat rule.
